text:
dana: Heads-up I opened a PR to update model cards for the orion family with clear compatibility and deprecation notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2953

rachel: thanks. what's the scope? examples, limits, or migration guide too?

dana: examples + small migration guide + a one-line matrix for streaming/embeddings/long-context. also a short JS SDK v3 snippet showing embed vs generate.

docs-bot: PR opened by dana in redwood-inference/docs (#2953)  labels: docs, needs-review

tom: can you paste the JS snippet here so I can sanity-check the auth pattern?

isha: quick note: orion-quant-xx currently returns different token counts for the same prompt vs float variants, so call that out under "known quirks". Bench has numbers.

dana: pasted below  JS SDK v3 minimal examples and a curl embed. also included a "token-count check" command for bench to run.

dana: ```js
// generate (js sdk v3)
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY);
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'orion7b-quant', input: 'Explain ACID in one sentence', max_tokens: 40 });
console.log(res.output[0].content);

// embeddings (js)
const emb = await client.embeddings({ model: 'orion7b-embed-quant', input: 'ACID database semantics' });
console.log(emb[0].vector.length);
```

dana: 
# curl token-count helper
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokenize" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"orion7b-quant","input":"test input for token count"}' | jq '.tokens | length'
```

bench-team: ran token checks  quant variants are ~12% smaller per token but alignment differs. we'll attach bench logs to the PR.

rachel: please add a clear callout: "Streaming: limited support on quant variants; if you rely on chunked streaming, use float variants." make it bold in the card.

isha: also add a tiny migration checklist for customers: 1) pin float model in canary, 2) run eval set `evals/orion-migration-2026-04` on canary, 3) monitor 'generation_latency' and 'token_cost' metrics, 4) rollback if >10% latency regressions.

dana: added the checklist and linked to the migration issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/429. Also switched internal links to relative paths (/model-catalog/orion7b).

ops-bot: reminder: internal link policy requires no absolute github.com links in published site. Please use relative or canonical docs links.

tom: I noticed a small wording thing under "limits"  we should not use "300k tokens" without clarifying it's context-window for float variants only. I changed the phrasing in the PR.

dana: good catch, updated. Also added a short bench reproduction: a curl + --compressed example that seeds the KV cache so bench can reproduce cold vs warm.

bench-team: attached perf gist and gave :+1: for the content. small request: include the SentEval id for regression tracking (senteval-orion-0426).

dana: added SentEval id and a snippet for creating a regression alert in the console (one-liner).

rachel: last pass: can we include a short note about SDK naming conventions for quant variants? users keep confusing -embed suffix vs separate models. maybe a one-liner under examples.

dana: done  added "Note: embedding variants often have '-embed' suffix; using a non-embed model for embeddings will error."

docs-bot: label `docs:needs-review` -> `docs:reviewing` (assigned to rachel)

rachel: I'll do a copy edit and merge after bench artifacts are linked. thanks all.

dana: thanks team :rocket:
